text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $61k with minimal movement, while Ethereum has dipped slightly, suggesting mild underperformance of the broader altcoin sector despite moderate volume. The Fear & Greed index sits at extreme fear with no improvement over the past week, and Bitcoin's dominance climbing to 58.1% signals investors are rotating toward the safer major asset during this period of uncertainty. Total volume at $93B remains subdued relative to recent peaks, indicating hesitation rather than panic selling.
